claims.claim: Final metric is pooled row-level RMSE.
claims.implication: All CV aggregation must pool scored rows; per-well averages are diagnostic only.

claims.claim: Hidden test contains roughly 200 wells; visible test contains only a few train-derived authoring examples.
claims.implication: Visible test overlap cannot validate hidden-test generalization.

claims.claim: Training has 773 wells and every simulated target mask is a suffix.
claims.implication: Use whole-well hidden-suffix simulation.

claims.claim: Last-known-TVT continuation has about 15.91 pooled RMSE locally.
claims.implication: Every formulation must beat this and report delta.

claims.claim: Most high-frequency TVT variation is inherited from known trajectory; smooth U=TVT+Z is the main target.
claims.implication: Model U level/trend and convert back to TVT.

claims.claim: A small fraction of wells dominates squared error.
claims.implication: Report worst-well and SSE concentration metrics for every run.

claims.claim: Per-well mean/datum error explains a large fraction of SSE.
claims.implication: Decompose residual into datum, trend and shape.

claims.claim: Aggregate grouped CV ordering can invert on the public leaderboard.
claims.implication: Require controls, repeated folds, harsher splits and final-family diversity.

claims.claim: A weak standalone model can improve a strong ensemble when residual correlation is low.
claims.implication: Optimize ensemble weights on OOF residual covariance, not standalone score.

claims.claim: Individually validated corrections can harm when stacked.
claims.implication: Test every component in final placement and retain negative configurations.

claims.claim: Risk detection is easier than predicting the signed correction direction.
claims.implication: Do not actuate a gate without signed-direction evidence.

claims.claim: Copied notebook uses seven named external datasets and one opaque mount.
claims.implication: Treat it as an idea catalogue, not a reproducible baseline.

claims.claim: Three named notebook datasets show unknown licenses.
claims.implication: Quarantine those artifacts pending license/provenance resolution.

claims.claim: Participants report tabular, non-tabular and pure-physics systems in the 5.x–6.x range.
claims.implication: Maintain multiple formulation tracks; do not copy undisclosed claims.

claims.claim: Known-prefix typewell alignment quality has local correlation about 0.454 with hidden oracle quality.
claims.implication: Use alignment quality as a feature/gate, not as definitive selector.

claims.claim: Hidden-zone GR missingness is substantial and highly variable.
claims.implication: Add missingness-aware regimes and no-GR fallbacks.

claims.claim: Across all 773 training wells, hidden-label oracle constant and line paths score 9.0354 and 6.6972, while a robust smooth curve scores 3.1106.
claims.implication: A gold-targeting legal bank must recover nonlinear whole-tail shape; datum-only and line-only optimization are insufficient.

claims.claim: Pilkwang's fixed PF/beam selector scores 10.5831 pooled RMSE and its worst decile contributes 61.95% of SSE.
claims.implication: Measure candidate oracle coverage separately from legal selector regret and catastrophe probability.

claims.claim: Heel affine GR calibration worsened ±2 ft datum localization from 89.13% to 85.77% and p90 shift from 3.4 ft to 7.0 ft.
claims.implication: Use affine parameters as mismatch diagnostics, not a default GR correction.

claims.claim: Amer's exact second-order HMM provides a deterministic posterior mean/std over joint TVT position and dip rate; its reported 4.57 PF-HMM blend is based on a small sample.
claims.implication: Add HMM outputs to a fresh candidate bank and validate on all frozen maps before promotion.

claims.claim: The public 6.979 notebook and high-vote derivatives combine pretrained artifacts, model packages, overlap contacts, and fixed bias corrections.
claims.implication: Treat their leaderboard scores as composite references, not clean unseen-well causal evidence.

claims.claim: Participants report grouped whole-well pooled CV in the 4.x range using complete-well models and test-time inputs.
claims.implication: Prioritize whole-well nonlinear candidates, but require independent reproduction and frozen controls.

claims.claim: Kaggle listed 134 competition topics on 2026-07-20 while the frozen archive contained 132.
claims.implication: Superseded by the later observed count; canonical counts still require a complete recrawl.

claims.claim: On 2026-07-22 the public leaderboard was 4.859 at rank 1, 4.913 at rank 2, 5.265 at rank 5, and 5.523 at rank 10.
claims.implication: A solo top-five attempt currently needs a score below about 5.265, with margin for continued movement.

claims.claim: The current P100/ANCC, public 6.40/6.768, MHA 6.832, high-vote public TVT, and related forks share a composite pretrained/PF/contact/overlap lineage and several unknown-license dependencies.
claims.implication: Treat their scores as composite references; clean-room test mechanisms separately and keep artifacts, overlap constants, and unknown-license inputs quarantined.

claims.claim: The public 6.40 guard's 0.055 overlap calibration activates exactly the three visible train-overlap wells and declares unchanged fallback for unseen wells.
claims.implication: The 6.40 title does not establish hidden unseen-well gain from that calibration layer.

claims.claim: P100's 128-seed branch hedge moves only visible well 00e12e8b by +2.0 ft; its model-package correction is disabled by its own p95-difference guard.
claims.implication: PF branch mass/separation is a hypothesis-generating uncertainty feature, but the public well shift and package result are not unseen-well evidence.

claims.claim: The public well-level GBDT gate worsens OOF RMSE from 10.3723 to 10.3824 and p90 from 14.6850 to 14.8066, so its own gate remains inactive.
claims.confidence: confirmed within that composite feature pipeline
claims.implication: Do not copy this shallow residual gate; any well-level correction needs a fresh legal feature representation and frozen transfer controls.

claims.claim: A participant's 15-minute three-well notebook implies roughly 17 hours over about 200 hidden wells; the discussion recommends targeting approximately five visible-test minutes after overhead margin.
claims.confidence: strong operational warning; not an official formula
claims.implication: Require pseudo-hidden inference benchmarks over roughly 200 wells before packaging any finalist.

claims.claim: New participant comments report hardware-dependent GPU variance and more stable CV/LB behavior for simpler models than opaque multipart ensembles.
claims.confidence: unverified but consistent with prior CV/LB inversion evidence
claims.implication: Preserve deterministic reproduction, report variance across seeds/hardware where relevant, and do not infer causality from public ensemble scores.

claims.claim: ROGII's public leaderboard scores exactly 26% of the test data and the private leaderboard scores the remaining 74%.
claims.implication: Public score is a minority-split diagnostic and may not authorize score-directed routing, well overrides, or final promotion without frozen local evidence.

claims.claim: The BirdCLEF+ 2026 first-place system was a diverse ensemble combining global CNNs, native Perch, an Amphibia/Insecta specialist, and a genus specialist with distillation, controlled Noisy Student self-training, validation, and pipeline-specific post-processing.
claims.implication: Transfer the system-design principle only; no single component or public score is causal proof for ROGII.

claims.claim: The BirdCLEF Amphibia/Insecta specialist was a supervised-only restricted-label model whose masked outputs were scattered into the full ensemble; it was not the whole solution or a universal routing rule.
claims.implication: A ROGII regime expert must be narrow, bounded, legally routed, and evaluated only in final system placement against an exact global fallback.

claims.claim: The winning BirdCLEF self-training controlled noise by capping pseudo-label mass below focal-label mass, separating labeled-soundscape and pseudo-label injection, retaining clean labeled soundscapes, and stopping after the third iteration regressed.
claims.implication: Any future weak-label or self-training mechanism requires bounded influence, non-overlapping controls, iteration stopping rules, and negative controls before promotion.

claims.claim: BirdCLEF specialists and diverse members were accepted only as parts of a complete system validated across complementary domain-tailored splits and separately tuned post-processing pipelines.
claims.implication: ROGII specialist evidence must exceed global-model evidence: sufficient regime support, cross-fitted routing, complete-system improvement, subgroup stability, failed negative controls, and exact fallback identity.

claims.claim: The independently reproduced E011 candidate spline4_ridge_equal_s075 reaches 12.5507562957 pooled RMSE versus E006 at 14.9331407872, a gain of 2.3823844915.
claims.implication: Low-dimensional nonlinear coefficient learning is statistically promoted and materially closes the E010 selector gap.

claims.claim: E011 improves all five repeated maps, all 25 repeated outer cells, every spatial and typewell holdout, and all three registered special slices while all 21 controls pass.
claims.implication: E011 passes its frozen statistical promotion contract, including shift, tail, negative-control, fallback, runtime, and memory gates.

claims.claim: E011 is not deployment-ready because no verified inference package, exact local-notebook parity, hidden-scale runtime benchmark, or private internet-disabled Kaggle parity exists.
claims.implication: Closed by D020 after the saved Kaggle version completed and its outputs passed review; E011 is deployment primary.

claims.claim: E011 saved Kaggle version 1 completed and produced a valid 14,151-row submission, COMPLETE receipt, and three well diagnostics; E011 is deployment primary and no competition submission was made.
claims.implication: Use E011 as the exact global primary for all subsequent research and deployment comparisons.

claims.claim: E012 tested 226 preliminary specialist branches and nine complete nested confirmation branches; the best formal branch gained only 0.013698 RMSE and failed cell/spatial/typewell gates.
claims.implication: Do not reopen hard regimes, local experts, latent routing, or partial pooling around E011 without a new mechanism.

claims.claim: On 2026-07-23 the public leaderboard was 4.859 at rank 1, 4.905 at rank 2, 5.265 at rank 5, and 5.511 at rank 10.
claims.implication: The visible frontier continues to move, but score movement alone does not identify a causal mechanism.

claims.claim: Kaggle New and Recent reported 138 competition topics on 2026-07-23 while the canonical archive remains 132 topics and 981 messages.
claims.confidence: confirmed observed count; canonical delta incomplete
claims.implication: Retain the canonical archive until a complete recrawl verifies all added or removed topics and message counts.

claims.claim: The new AI coding-assistant discussion contains no organizer answer; its only reply links an unrelated writeup.
claims.confidence: confirmed thread content; no rule conclusion
claims.implication: Do not infer a disclosure or rule change from this thread; continue following official competition rules.

claims.claim: A participant reports PF posterior spread correlation near +0.23 with error and a small five-seed PF gain, suggesting uncertainty may be more useful as a trust feature than as a direct predictor.
claims.implication: Screen continuous uncertainty-conditioned placement locally; do not import reported constants or performance values.

claims.claim: Four current frontier notebooks share 93.1%–99.95% source-sequence similarity, the same active composite profile, and the same quarantined artifact lineage.
claims.implication: Treat their titles and scores as one composite lineage, not independent mechanism evidence.

claims.claim: Exact PF branch-hedge and U-continuity outputs act materially only on visible overlap well 00e12e8b; the branch hedge adds +2.0 ft and continuity adds about 2.04 ft maximum.
claims.implication: Branch mass/separation and continuity are hypotheses only; the public thresholds and shifts are not unseen-well evidence.

claims.claim: The public Full-Stack Selector CV100 reports 11.3803 pooled RMSE on 100 wells, worst-decile SSE share 68.61%, and zero bimodal or heel-calibration activations.
claims.confidence: confirmed within a small composite sample
claims.implication: The report does not isolate a causal branch or establish full-data transfer; do not promote or reproduce the stack.

claims.claim: The public stochastic-TTA GBDT gate improves OOF RMSE by only 0.00379 while worsening p90 by 0.06273, so its own gate remains inactive.
claims.implication: Do not copy the correction; stochastic disagreement may be retained only as a diagnostic hypothesis.

claims.claim: The geographic-restoration notebook declares no external datasets but Kaggle CLI returns a zero-byte source file.
claims.implication: No technical, validation, or causality claim may be made from its title or score.

claims.claim: Per-well oracle choice between E011 and E006 reaches 11.7920 RMSE and continuous per-well blending reaches 11.7172, gains of 0.7587 and 0.8335 versus E011.
claims.implication: Fallback opportunity exists with hidden knowledge, but oracle headroom alone cannot authorize routing.

claims.claim: Seven legal cross-fitted uncertainty families fail to recover E011/E006 oracle headroom; hard logistic is best at +0.006868 RMSE, 2/5 maps and 5/25 cells, with transfer failures.
claims.implication: Reject H016/E013 and do not retune fallback or blend models over the same legal well-level feature space.

claims.claim: T022 reproduces all ten candidate outputs over 35 contexts at zero metric delta; all controls and ten edge groups pass.
claims.implication: The negative uncertainty-routing conclusion is complete and reproducible.

hypotheses.title: Surface-target formulation
hypotheses.statement: Predicting smooth U=TVT+Z level and trend will outperform direct TVT regression under repeated whole-well suffix CV.
hypotheses.evidence_for: Two winning notes and physical decomposition.
hypotheses.next_test: Build flat, linear, quadratic and robust-spline U baselines with identical folds.

hypotheses.title: Candidate residual tabular stack
hypotheses.statement: Tree models over legal trajectory, prefix, alignment and candidate-path features can improve a physics candidate without learning raw row TVT directly.
hypotheses.evidence_against: CV/LB inversion and artifact leakage risk.
hypotheses.next_test: Positive-control feature pack, then no-op/duplicate/shuffle controls.

hypotheses.title: Decorrelated sequence correction
hypotheses.statement: A small sequence correction trained on candidate residuals can improve a strong structural baseline when OOF error correlation is low.
hypotheses.evidence_against: Many neural architectures plateaued or overfit.
hypotheses.next_test: Small GRU/TCN with strict ablation and residual-correlation report.

hypotheses.title: Risk without actuation
hypotheses.statement: Uncertainty features can identify expensive wells but cannot safely choose correction sign.
hypotheses.evidence_against: A signed proxy may exist in prefix backtests.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure AUC/rank correlation separately from signed datum correlation.

hypotheses.title: Self-correlation candidate
hypotheses.statement: Horizontal pre-PS GR self-correlation provides a useful candidate independent of typewell matching for selected regimes.
hypotheses.next_test: Implement legal prefix-template correlation with shuffled-template control.

hypotheses.title: Spatial datum prior
hypotheses.statement: Legal cross-well spatial/context features can reduce datum error under leave-spatial-out validation.
hypotheses.evidence_for: Local offset structure and discussion interest.
hypotheses.evidence_against: Winning note reports non-transfer and coordinate uncertainty.
hypotheses.next_test: First prove coordinate semantics and pass leave-spatial/typewell-out control.
